description: This source file implements WebSocket-based communication for a gateway connection, including protocols, session management, connection handling, message encoding/decoding, and reconnection logic in a client designed for real-time communication with a server infrastructure.

classes.name: WebSocketTasking
classes.description: A protocol defining WebSocket task operations such as resume, cancel, send, and receive.

classes.name: WebSocketSessioning
classes.description: A protocol for creating WebSocket tasks.

classes.name: WebSocketTaskBox
classes.description: A boxed, thread-safe wrapper around WebSocket tasks conforming to WebSocketTasking.

classes.name: WebSocketSessionBox
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper around WebSocket sessions conforming to WebSocketSessioning.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for establishing a gateway connection, including role, scopes, features, and credentials.

classes.name: GatewayAuthSource
classes.description: Enumeration of possible authentication sources such as device token, shared token, bootstrap token, password, or none.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: An actor managing WebSocket connection lifecycle, message handling, reconnection logic, and authentication for gateway communication.

methods.name: WebSocketTaskBox.cancel
methods.description: Cancels the WebSocket task with a specified close code and reason.

methods.name: WebSocketTaskBox.send
methods.description: Sends a message asynchronously through the WebSocket task.

methods.name: WebSocketTaskBox.receive
methods.description: Receives a message asynchronously from the WebSocket task.

methods.name: WebSocketSessioning.makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket task for a given URL.

methods.name: GatewayChannelActor.connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the gateway, including authentication and initial handshake.

methods.name: GatewayChannelActor.shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the WebSocket connection and related tasks.
